title: Agent Communication Protocol v1.0
description: Envelope for every agent-to-agent message. See core/agent_protocol.md for rationale.

from.description: Agent name of the sender (must be in registry.json).

to.description: Agent name of the receiver (must be in registry.json).

trace_id.description: Unique per message; forms causal chain via payload.in_reply_to.

context_ref.description: sha256 of the context bundle the sender used (see core/context_engine.py::context_hash).
